strings.home.desc: A privacy-first AI assistant built for cybersecurity professionals. Red and blue team work, vulnerability research, secure code review, OSINT and everyday engineering — fast, technical, and to the point. Runs entirely offline on your machine.
strings.home.features_sub: Everything you need for professional AI-powered security research.
strings.feat.privacy.d: Runs 100% locally. No account, no cloud, no tracking, no data stored.
strings.feat.depth.d: Professional-grade answers for security research, code review and engineering.
strings.feat.code.d: Generate, review and debug code across all major languages.
strings.feat.fast.d: Runs on your own hardware — no latency, no queues, always available.
strings.feat.ethical.d: Tuned to answer without the usual refusals — no sanitized, hedged replies.
strings.chat.hint: Enter to send  ·  Shift+Enter for a new line  ·  Ctrl+L to clear
strings.conv.title: History
strings.chat.empty_sub: Select a model and start chatting. Everything runs locally.
strings.chat.no_model: No model is ready. Open Models to download a tier and select it.
strings.chat.attach_hint: Attach an image — vision models only
strings.chat.not_vision: This model cannot read images. Select a WormGPT Image model.
strings.models.title: Models
strings.models.sub: Tiers are ranked by power and machine requirements. Downloads happen locally, once per model.
strings.models.confirm_delete: Delete {model} ({size})? The files will be removed from disk.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.engine_desc: Local inference engine — fully offline, nothing leaves your machine.
strings.wizard.appearance_sub: Pick an accent colour and the settings that fit your machine. Everything below applies instantly and stays editable in Settings.
strings.wizard.identity_step: Who are you? Who is your AI?
strings.wizard.identity_sub: Your name personalizes the greeting; the AI name is what your assistant calls itself.
strings.wizard.persona_sub: Every preset is fully uncensored. You can edit the system prompt yourself later.
strings.wizard.welcome_desc: WormGPT runs entirely on your machine — no account, no cloud, no tracking. Pick a model tier, configure your assistant, and start chatting in seconds.
strings.wizard.model_sub: Higher tiers are more powerful but need more RAM. You can switch or download another tier anytime.
strings.wizard.assistant_sub: Choose a personality preset. You can change everything later in Settings.
strings.wizard.finish_sub: Review your setup, then launch WormGPT.
strings.tools.title: Local Commands
strings.tools.note: Full agent mode, exactly like Claude Code: the model can read, write and edit files, list/glob/grep folders, run shell commands and do passive OSINT — chaining tools until the task is done. Off by default. 'Ask' shows every command for approval.
strings.search.note: Lets the model query the web (DuckDuckGo / Wikipedia) and reason over the results. Requires network access.
strings.sys.title: System & Recommendations
strings.sys.no_model_installed: Recommended model {model} is not installed yet — download it in Models.
strings.server.title: Local Server
strings.server.base: Base URL: http://{host}:{port}/v1  ·  API key: wormgpt
strings.server.note:
OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible. Point Claude Code at it with:
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:{port} ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=wormgpt
strings.err.no_model: No model loaded — open WormGPT and select a model first.
strings.status.not_installed: No model installed — download one in Models
strings.status.space: Not enough free disk space for {model} ({size} needed)
strings.feat.dolphin.d: The famous uncensored Dolphin models, ready to run fully offline.
strings.feat.library.d: 15 models ranked by power and machine requirements, from WormGPT-1 to WormGPT Draw-2. Every chat model is genuinely uncensored.
strings.chat.gen_hint: Generate an image with the local image server
strings.reason.label: Reasoning
strings.chat.loading_wait: Model still loading — try again in a few seconds.
strings.settings.uncensored.d: Removes every remaining restriction from the model's behaviour.
strings.settings.accent.d: Changes the glow of the entire interface.
strings.settings.contact.d: A question, a model that refuses to load or an idea for the next version — reach me on Discord.
strings.chat.no_models_installed: No models installed — open the Models tab to download one.
strings.chat.genimg.title: Image generation
strings.chat.genimg.none: No image generation model downloaded. Open Models > Image Gen first.
strings.settings.reset.confirm: Erase ALL settings (including your profile) and restart from scratch? Downloaded models are kept on disk.
strings.settings.reset.title: Factory reset
strings.models.cat.genimg: Image generation — create pictures from text, fully offline.
strings.image.title: Image Generation
strings.image.desc: Generate images through your local Stable Diffusion server.
strings.image.no_server: No image server at {url}. Start your Stable Diffusion server first.
strings.image.note: Point this at a local Stable Diffusion WebUI (default http://127.0.0.1:7860). The app sends the prompt and displays the result.
strings.settings.api.d: Connect a cloud provider: its models are added to the model menu automatically and run alongside your local models.
strings.settings.api.keykeep: leave empty to keep the saved key
strings.settings.api.xkiro_note: xKiro also exposes free cloud models (Mistral, Codestral, SenseNova). Once your key is saved and tested, they appear at the bottom of the model list automatically — and disappear by themselves if the API stops answering.
strings.wizard.agent_note: Let the AI run local commands on this machine (ask before each run, or fully automatic).
strings.wizard.api_step.d: Paste your xKiro key to unlock free cloud models (Mistral Large 3, Codestral…). You can skip this — local models work without it.
strings.specs.title: Performance & specs
strings.specs.sub: Everything the engine and your machine are doing, in real time.
strings.specs.reset.confirm: Reset the statistics? Session counters and the per-model history will be cleared.
strings.specs.nogpu: No GPU detected — running on CPU.
strings.specs.nodata: No data yet — chat with a model to fill this in.
